pages.text: $(o)A three-headed horror you build yourself, from soul sand and wither skeleton skulls.$()$(br2)$(l)Counter:$() Below half health it shrugs off arrows and bolts. Archers, bring a blade for the second half.$(br2)Summon it far from anything you love. It smashes blocks when it is hurt.
$(l)Defeated.$()$(br2)Its $(item)Ashen Skull Shard$() counts for the quest book.
